layout.title: Caprock — Discover Life at Caprock
layout.description: An elevated workforce community in Mobeetie, Texas, designed for comfort, connection, and life on site.

hero.title: Discover Life at Caprock
hero.subtitle: An Elevated Workforce Community
hero.intro: Built for people powering progress, Caprock is designed to provide a comfortable, connected, and convenient living experience while working on site.

intro.title: More than workforce housing.
intro.p1: Caprock is a welcoming, service-driven community designed to help residents recharge, connect, and feel supported throughout their stay.
intro.p2: From modern single-occupancy accommodations to energizing recreation spaces and a variety of dining options, every aspect of the community is thoughtfully designed to support your daily life, wellbeing, and sense of connection.

amenities.title: Designed for the whole day.
amenities.intro: After the workday, stay active, share a meal with coworkers, or take time to reset. Every experience is built around comfort, convenience, and connection.

items.title: Single Occupancy Rooms
items.desc: Private, fully furnished rooms with climate control and Wi-Fi.

items.title: Wellness Center
items.desc: Weight rooms and recovery spaces to keep you at your best.

items.title: Sports & Recreation
items.desc: Soccer fields, pickleball, basketball, and a golf simulator.

items.title: On-Site Dining
items.desc: Freshly prepared meals, grab-and-go, and food trucks.

items.title: RV Park
items.desc: Full-service RV accommodations with access to every amenity.

items.title: Shuttle & Security
items.desc: Reliable shuttle services and 24/7 guest services on site.

location.title: Conveniently located in the Texas panhandle.
location.intro: Caprock sits near regional cities and transportation hubs, with accessible travel options from across the country.

housing.title: Modern spaces. Built for the long stay.
housing.p1: Thoughtfully designed for extended stays and workforce living, our accommodations support both rest and productivity — so residents can settle in, recharge, and feel at home.

cta.title: Ready to call Caprock home?
cta.subtitle: Register or learn more about life on site.
